We have two cards:

CARD 1: result_claim: The agent claimed that order #W2575533 contains only one garden hose item: a black vinyl hose 50 ft with ID 5206946487.
policy requires: User must be authenticated before providing order information.
applies when: when providing order information
policy quote: provide information about their own profile, orders, and related products

CARD 2: required_action_missing: The agent did not show that they authenticated the user before providing order information.
policy requires: Authenticate the user by locating user id via email or name+zip code before any action.
applies when: when providing order information
policy quote: At the beginning of the conversation, you have to authenticate the user identity by locating their user id via email, or via name + zip code. This has to be done even when the user already provides the user id.

We need to see if the agent indeed provided order information without authentication. The agent's response (ход 13) says: "Я понимаю ваше беспокойство, и я действительно очень внимательно изучила детали вашего заказа #W2575533. Согласно данным из системы, в этом заказе присутствует только один товар в категории садовых шлангов — именно тот, о котором я говорила: черный виниловый шланг длиной 50 футов с ID 5206946487. Других шлангов в этом заказе просто нет."
